months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(1998년 2월 낙동강 하구, 10–11월 서해·남해 섬, 2025년 4월 제주).

summary: 북아메리카에서 번식하는 새로, 우리나라에서는 1998년 2월 낙동강 하구에서 처음 기록된 뒤 가거도·백령도·흑산도·제주도 등에서 가을과 봄에 몇 차례 기록된 길잃은새이다. 탁 트인 풀밭과 농경지, 바닷가 초지에서 주로 땅 위를 걷거나 뛰어다니며 풀씨와 곤충을 먹는다. 알래스카와 캐나다, 미국 북부에서 멕시코와 과테말라에 걸쳐 번식하고 북쪽 무리는 겨울에 멕시코와 중앙아메리카, 서인도 제도 등으로 내려가며, 일본에서도 드문 겨울철새나 나그네새로 기록된다.

heavy dark streaking on the breast and flanks

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 더 크다.

young: 어린새는 어른새와 비슷하나 전체적으로 담황색을 더 띠고 가슴과 옆구리의 세로줄이 더 굵고 많으며, 멱과 앞목에도 작은 검은 점이 있다.

art.subject: Savannah Sparrow (Passerculus sandwichensis), adult (sexes alike), a vagrant in Korean coastal grassland in autumn: crown streaked brown and black with a thin pale central stripe; a supercilium that is yellow in front of and above the eye and whitish behind; brown ear coverts outlined by a dark eye-stripe and a thin dark moustache, with a whitish submoustachial stripe and a dark malar stripe; upperparts grey-brown with bold dark streaks; wings brown with pale-fringed coverts and tertials; underparts white with crisp dark-brown streaks across the breast and along the flanks, often merging into a small central breast spot; tail short, notched, brown. Bill small, conical, pinkish with a darker culmen; eye dark; legs pink.
art.pose: perched on a dry grass stem, side view
art.scene: short coastal grassland with dry grasses near a Korean shore in autumn (October), warm light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a grass stem: narrow whitish crown stripe, supercilium yellow in front of the eye and whitish behind, brown cheeks, white throat with a dark malar stripe, streaked grey-brown upperparts, white underparts heavily streaked dark brown on the breast and flanks, short notched tail, small pinkish conical bill, pink legs

adult, three-quarter front view standing on short grass: narrow whitish crown stripe, yellow in front of the eye, brown cheeks, white throat, crisp dark streaks across the white breast and along the flanks
art.build: A small, slim sparrow, slightly smaller and slimmer than a House Sparrow, with a small head, rather flat crown and short notched tail; runs mouse-like through short grass and perches upright on low stems. Bill small, conical, pinkish, much shorter than the head. Legs pink, medium length. Tail short with a notched tip and no white sides.
avoid: Do not paint white outer tail feathers or a long tail as in buntings and pipits; Savannah Sparrow's short notched tail has no white.
Do not paint a chestnut face (Little Bunting) or a crest (Rustic Bunting).
Do not paint a thin pipit bill; the bill is small and conical.
Do not omit the yellow in the supercilium in front of the eye.
